BiblicalUsage: Keylaph is a club or sledge-hammer, a heavy tool for breaking. Psalms 74:6 shows the enemy using axes and hammers to break down the carved work of the sanctuary all at once.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hammer in this psalm is a warning that what took generations of craftsmen to carve can be smashed in a day when God lets the enemy in.
